payload.name: pc-check-flag
payload.description: Validate an exact boolean flag from raw inputs and return a valid/flag result object. Reads inputs.get("flag") with a presence branch so missing and null are distinct invalid outcomes. Only the exact booleans True and False are valid; any other value (including non-boolean types) is invalid. Uses a small helper is_exact_flag and invokes it at module scope to assign result. Returns {valid: boolean, flag: original bool if valid else null}. No imports, I/O, host calls, exceptions or type coercion. Pure logic, zero host calls.
